correctness.rationale: Known natural reduced Światkowski star chain complex is 0 -> A_Z tensor Sym^(n-1)E_Z -> Sym^n E_Z -> 0; quotient by differences is Z, and the kernel is free. Symmetric equivariant splitting E_Q=trivial+augmentation separates multiplication maps; characteristic-zero Pieri kernels are hook Schur modules. Exterior Koszul resolution of regular differences validates integral syzygy presentation. Exact trace and finite group averaging prove character and first invariants threshold. Standalone independently constructed cubical fixed-cell Lefschetz computations check 11 parameter pairs across every conjugacy type; no finite computation substitutes for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural collision-free star graph braid spaces with known Betti ranks have a nontrivial canonical full arm-permutation symmetry. The new all-parameter rational module and class-character formula, integral syzygy presentation, and uniform five-particle onset of invariant cycles structurally distinguish motions unobservable from ranks. This is an infinite family with a mathematically natural invariant and a sharp threshold; it does not claim that the existing general chain complex or known rank is novel.
